basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old graphic designer living in Portland, Oregon. I recently discovered Reddit and have been enjoying exploring various communities. I have a keen interest in audio equipment and mental health discussions, and I'm a huge fan of the TV show MXC. In my free time, I love exploring the local music scene and experimenting with digital art. I'm single and usually online during the evenings after work, around 8 PM to 11 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for five years. I've self-taught myself much about audio equipment through online forums and YouTube tutorials. I'm also interested in mental health topics, which I explore through subreddits and articles.
